about: Questions waiting to become answer pages under /answers/:slug, in priority order. The weekly workflow (.github/workflows/answers-weekly.yml) offers the first three open candidates in its issue. A candidate is a question a PE or VC backed media, adtech or data leader asks, in their words; it is never a claim. Cadence, sourcing and the quality bar live in 01_CANON.md under 'The answer pages'. Set status to published and add the slug when the page merges.
